gallery.about.body:
Welcome to MWNF Galleries!  
  
Each of our Galleries focuses on a specific medium, which means a specific material or type of object. This Gallery is dedicated to **Historical Cars**. It is a new Gallery that is constantly being expanded.  
  
*Historical Cars* is a dedicated space for enthusiasts and those interested in the heritage of automotive history. The evolution of cars and their value as artworks are at the core of this Gallery. Different types of communication vehicles provide the context for a great variety of cars from their invention to the present. Palanquins, coaches, carriages, trucks, army vehicles or motorcycles as well as related items such as images, paintings, accessories or toys ensure an inspiring journey.  
  
We suggest you start your visit in the [Collection](< https://cars.museumwnf.org/collection>), where a range of filters offers different options to explore the available material. For research, you can use the **Search** bar, located on the top right of the page. If you are interested in learning about contributions from a specific institution, the [Partner](https://cars.museumwnf.org/partners) section would be the best place to start. On the [Timeline](< https://cars.museumwnf.org/timeline>) you will find countries’ historical context information, while [My Collection](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php) lets you add any item from this project to your personal collection.  
  
Please be aware that the **Search** tool covers only the artefacts in this Gallery. If you wish to carry out a search in the overall MWNF Database, please click [here](https://www.museumwnf.org/database_searchform.php) or go to the above-mentioned projects to search their databases.
